response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and systems engineer, but their profile fundamentally misses the mandatory requirements: their C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month role in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. They also lack any Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital is a startup investment platform, not capital markets systems work), and show no SQL Server/Oracle background.
strengths: Strong low-latency systems experience (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development
Broad technical versatility across languages, platforms, and infrastructure
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and dated (~7 months in 2014–2015), versus 5–10 years required
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; recent stack is TypeScript/Node/MongoDB

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and performance-systems background
